messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock down outreach policy edge cases for the postmortem on the API timeout incident. Who claims the 72h customer note and the public timeline?
tim: I can take the 72h customer note (draft). Will need help from SRE for the timeline accuracy.
devon: SRE can own the timeline. I'll pull logs and timeline entries by EOD.
elaine: For public timeline language: prefer neutral phrasing, avoid internal-only terms. Example snippet: 
```
We experienced increased request latency between 03:12–04:05 UTC due to autoscaler cold starts. User requests were served, but response times degraded.
```
zoe: +1 on neutral wording. For sharing the detailed root cause analysis with customers, we should decide redaction rules first. Legal flagged credential leakage wording earlier.
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem doc created: https://redwood/pms/incident-1751202468 (editable)
maria: Redaction rules proposal: no IPs, no third-party auth tokens, aggregate counts only. If a customer specifically requests deeper logs, route to support + legal.
tim: That works. Also propose owners and deadlines: 72h note (tim) — draft by 72h, review by legal + SRE within 24h of draft; Public timeline (devon) — draft by 48h; Full root cause analysis (maria) — owner for internal RCA and decision on redaction to decide sharing.
devon: Adding action items to tracker now: 
- ACTION-1751: Draft public timeline (devon) — due +2d
- ACTION-1752: Draft 72h customer note (tim) — due +3d
- ACTION-1753: Redaction & legal review (legal, elaine) — due +4d
- ACTION-1754: Ownership handoff doc (maria) — due +5d
elaine: I'm ok to be the legal reviewer. For edgecases: if incident touches customer data, escalate to privacy team immediately.
zoe: Also let's flag this incident as part of a recurring pattern: autoscaler cold starts in last 3 incidents. Can we add a recurring-pattern tag so Platform Eng has visibility?
maria: Good call. I'll add recurrence tag and ping platform-eng. Also proposing a short playbook change: 1) check prefix cache config, 2) consider warm pools before midnight deploys.
tim: For customer-facing wording, slight tweak request: replace "cold starts" with "scaling delays" to be less technical.
devon: Agree — will use "scaling delays" in public-facing text, keep "cold start" in internal RCA.
zoe: Last item — who owns the follow-up verification that fixes are deployed? Suggest dedupe: Platform Eng owns deployment, SRE verifies metrics for 7 days (owner: devon).
maria: Agreed. Final: I'll compile all drafts into the postmortem doc and assign reviewers. Thanks everyone — please update the tracker when you start your action. :thumbsup:
